caption:
October prices rose 0.4% from September. 🛒⛽
BLS says shelter rose 0.3%, energy 0.7%, food 0.5%. Core prices were up 0.3%.
There's no yearly rate for October, because prices weren't collected during last year's shutdown. The last annual reading, for September, was 3.7%.
